title: The problem
caption: AI tasks are usually handed the whole record.
image_prompt: Flat vector tech illustration, dark navy background #0b0f14, mint green (#37e6a0) and light blue (#5aa7ff) accents. A database table row full of many labeled data icons (person silhouette, envelope, phone, calendar, house, ID card) all flowing on arrows straight into a glowing AI chip / neural network icon. Minimalist, no readable text, clean geometric icons, subtle grid background.

title: Ask: does the task need it?
caption: Remove one field, rerun the task, measure the difference.
image_prompt: Flat vector tech illustration, dark navy background #0b0f14, mint green (#37e6a0) accent. A row of small labeled icon tiles on a conveyor belt, one tile lifted out by a glowing robotic arm while a magnifying glass hovers over the row, subtle before/after split with a faint checkmark on one side and a faint X on the other. Minimalist, no readable text, clean geometric icons.

title: Evidence, not guesswork
caption: Every field gets an evidence card: block or retain.
image_prompt: Flat vector tech illustration, dark navy background #0b0f14. A glowing certificate or ID-card shaped panel floating in the center with a green checkmark seal on one corner and a red stop-sign icon on another corner, small bar-chart icon and a padlock icon beside it, mint green (#37e6a0) and red (#ff6b6b) accents, minimalist, no readable text.

title: Minimized SQL view
caption: The AI only ever sees a minimized, fail-closed SQL view.
image_prompt: Flat vector tech illustration, dark navy background #0b0f14. A narrow glowing funnel or window shape labeled by a simple grid icon (2x1 clean cells) feeding into an AI chip icon, mint green (#37e6a0) glow, while a much larger grid of table-column icons behind it is dimmed/greyed out and separated by a translucent wall. Minimalist, no readable text.

title: Encrypted at rest
caption: Everything else stays in the database, encrypted, never in plaintext.
image_prompt: Flat vector tech illustration, dark navy background #0b0f14. A large closed bank vault / safe icon with a glowing padlock, behind it stacked database cylinder icons, small scrambled binary/ciphertext glyphs floating near the vault door, light blue (#5aa7ff) and mint green (#37e6a0) accents, minimalist, no readable text.

title: Proven safe, at scale
caption: 10,000 simulated supplier events: real exposure risk cut sharply.
image_prompt: Flat vector tech illustration, dark navy background #0b0f14. A large descending bar chart or risk-meter dial glowing mint green (#37e6a0), tiny dots representing thousands of events flowing through three small factory/building icons (suppliers) into the chart, a shield icon overlaying the chart, minimalist, no readable text.

title: Necessity Certificate
caption: Build AI that needs less. Prove it.
image_prompt: Flat vector tech illustration, dark navy background #0b0f14, centered glowing shield-and-checkmark emblem made of circuit-board lines, mint green (#37e6a0) and light blue (#5aa7ff) accents, radiating subtle light rays, clean minimalist tech logo style, no readable text.
